description: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory consumption in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods applied to language models. The horizontal axis displays seven distinct methods labeled from left to right as “Full FT,” “MTL-FT,” “TAG,” “LoRA,” “QLoRA,” and “Ours,” with the final bar labeled “Ours” being colored green while all others are orange. The vertical axis, labeled “GPU Memory (GB),” is scaled linearly from 0 to 60 GB with tick marks at regular intervals of 20 GB. The bar corresponding to “Full FT” is the tallest, reaching approximately 70 GB, followed by “MTL-FT” at approximately 40 GB. The “TAG,” “LoRA,” and “QLoRA” methods each consume approximately 20 GB of memory. The “Ours” method consumes approximately 20 GB of memory, visually matching the height of the “TAG,” “LoRA,” and “QLoRA” bars. The bars are arranged in descending order of memory usage from left to right, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
